entities.name: CoaBC bifunctional enzyme
observations: Sequence matches reviewed CoaBC proteins at 43.9–45.2% identity across 95.5–95.7% query coverage, supporting a homology-based assignment.

Reference CoaBC catalyzes CTP-dependent ligation of (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate and L-cysteine to N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine, then decarboxylates that intermediate to (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine.
Reference annotations report FMN and Mg2+ cofactors; these are not experimentally confirmed for the query sequence.
